_meta.title: SDXL Expression Sheet
_meta.description: Expression variants using SDXL base. Text-prompted expressions without IPAdapter — consistent style from archetype prompt + expression keyword.

placeholder_tokens.{{EXPRESSION_PROMPT}}: Archetype prompt + expression keyword e.g. 'mercenary trader, angry expression'
placeholder_tokens.{{SEED}}: Integer seed — varies per expression for diversity
placeholder_tokens.{{EXPRESSION_NAME}}: Expression label (angry, playful, calm etc.) — not used in graph, metadata only
